RmlUi 6.2 -- the LAYOUT and MARKUP engine (MIT, see LICENSE.txt)

Source:   https://github.com/mikke89/RmlUi/releases/tag/6.2
Asset:    6.2.tar.gz (source tarball, 3,507,141 bytes)
SHA-256:  814c3ff7b9666280338d8f0dda85979f5daf028d01c85fc8975431d1e2fd8e8b
Released: 2026-01-11
Vendored: 2026-08-13

Authorized by: base/gui/SOFTANZA_GUI_PLAN.md §8, phase G0. That section
also carries the four kill criteria this vendor must survive, and §2.4
carries the only conditions under which the choice would be revisited.

WHAT IS HERE, and it is the CORE ONLY:

    Include/RmlUi/Config, Include/RmlUi/Core, Include/RmlUi/Core.h
    Source/Core            (140 .cpp)
    Source/Core/Elements   ( 26 .cpp)
    Source/Core/Layout     ( 17 .cpp)
                           --- 183 .cpp, 424 files, ~3.1 MB

WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE, and why each:

  Source/Core/FontEngineDefault  -- the FreeType font engine. Dropped at
      the root, not disabled at build time: RMLUI_FONT_ENGINE is off and
      the SheenBidi -> HarfBuzz -> stb_truetype pipeline this house
      already owns becomes THE implementation of FontEngineInterface
      (G2). Its removal is also why the vendored tree has ZERO external
      dependencies -- ft2build.h was the only one, and it lived here.
  Backends/          -- RmlUi's own GL/SDL/GLFW render and platform
      backends. The host supplies the renderer; that is constraint 2 of
      the four this engine was chosen to satisfy simultaneously. Taking
      a backend would put a second GPU surface outside the counted-
      fallback discipline, which is what killed NanoVG and raylib for
      the graphics plane.
  Samples/, Tests/, Utilities/, CMake/, CMakeLists.txt, .github/
  Source/Lua/        -- a scripting engine. Constraint 3 is NO second
      programming model; behaviour comes from the reactive layer.
  Source/Lottie/, Source/SVG/  -- each drags a dependency (rlottie,
      lunasvg) for a capability the graphics plane already has.
  Source/Debugger/   -- reconsider if a visual inspector is wanted; it
      is not a dependency of anything above.

EXTERNAL DEPENDENCIES: none. The only non-C++-standard includes across
the vendored tree are <ctype.h> <float.h> <limits.h> <stdarg.h>
<stddef.h> <stdint.h> <stdio.h> <stdlib.h> <string.h> and, on Windows,
<windows.h>.

The precedent this follows is harfbuzz/VERSION.txt in this same
directory: a large C++ vendor, compiled from source by zig c++ with no
cmake and no SDK. That precedent also says what to expect -- two Windows
lessons were collected the hard way there (a vendor-root file named
VERSION collides with C++'s <version> header on case-insensitive
filesystems, which is why this file is VERSION.txt; and a bare `text`
import shadowed bridge locals). RmlUi is larger. Whatever it costs is
recorded in the G0 STATUS section of the plan.

DO NOT FORK. Patches go upstream. A fork is a permanent tax -- Avalonia
deleted its second rendering backend for want of parity maintenance.
